name: Lindbergh S.p.A.
summary: Lindbergh S.p.A. specializes in providing comprehensive maintenance, repair, and logistical support services throughout Italy. The company's diverse offerings include the distribution of spare parts, efficient return management systems, supply of personal protective equipment (PPE), tool examination, responsible waste disposal, tailored and on-demand solutions, and professional work clothing and accessories. Founded in 2006, Lindbergh S.p.A. operates from its headquarters in Pescarolo ed Uniti, Italy.
